rules.name: Duty Before All
rules.text: Grey Knights Terminator units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.

rules.name: Hallowed Ground
rules.text: Certain areas of the battlefield are within your army's Hallowed Ground, as follows: - Your deployment zone is always within your army's Hallowed Ground. - The area of the battlefield within 6" of one or more Purifier Squad units from your army is within your army’s Hallowed Ground. - At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within No Man’s Land, until the end of that phase, No Man’s Land is within your army’s Hallowed Ground. - At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within your opponent’s deployment zone, until the end of that phase, your opponent’s deployment zone is within your army’s Hallowed Ground. Each time a model in a Grey Knights unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible target or makes a melee attack, re roll a Hit roll of 1. If that unit is a Purifier Squad and/or is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground, you can re roll the Hit roll instead.

rules.name: Fury of Titan
rules.text: Each time a unit from your army is set up using the Deep Strike rule, until the end of the turn, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

rules.name: Prescient Redeployment
rules.text: From the second battle round onwards, at the start of your Movement phase, if you did not select the maximum number of Grey Knights units from your army using the Gate of Infinity ability at the end of your opponent's previous turn, you can select one Grey Knights unit from your army that is on the battlefield that could have been selected using the Gate of Infinity ability. Remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. Designer's Note: This means that your unit can retain its position on the battlefield at the end of your Command phase, and then be placed into Strategic Reserves at the start of your Movement phase, to set it up again in your Reinforcements step in another position.

rules.name: Mailed Fist
rules.text: Each time a Grey Knights Vehicle unit from your army Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it; until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [Assault] ability.

rules.name: Channelled Force
rules.text: Each time a Grey Knights unit from your army is selected to fight, that unit can take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, select one of the following rules. Until the end of the phase, that unit has that rule. - Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit with the [Psychic] ability also have the [Sustained Hits 1] ability. - Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit with the [Psychic] ability also have the [Lethal Hits] ability.

rules.name: Mustering A Boarding Patrol
rules.text: You can include up to two of the following units (duplicates are not allowed): - Brother-Captain - Brother-Captain Stern - Brotherhood Champion - Brotherhood Chaplain - Brotherhood Librarian - Brotherhood Techmarine - Castellan Crowe - Grand Master - Grand Master Voldus - Kaldor Draigo You can include up to three of the following unit: - Strike Squad (5 or 10 models) You can include up to one of each of the following units: - Interceptor Squad (5 or 10 models) - Purifier Squad (5 models) You can include up to one of the following units: - Brotherhood Terminator Squad (5 models) - Paladin Squad (5 models)

rules.name: Rules Adaptions
rules.text: - The Brotherhood Librarian model loses the Vortex of Doom ability. - The Grand Master Voldus model loses the Hammer Aflame ability. - The Interceptor Squad unit loses the Personal Teleporters ability. - The Kaldor Draigo model loses the One With the Warp ability. - The Strike Squad unit loses the Sanctifying Ritual ability.

rules.name: An Urgent Duty
rules.text: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for Grey Knights units from your army.

rules.name: Eye of the Prognosticars
rules.text: Units from your army with the Teleport Assault ability replace that ability with this one. Each time you target this unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

rules.name: Pre-emptive Strike
rules.text: In the Reinforcements step of your first Movement phase, you can set up on the battlefield one Grey Knights Reserves unit from your army using the Deep Strike ability. When doing so, you can set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models (measure this distance as you would normally for the Deep Strike ability). Until the end of the turn that unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

rules.name: Dauntless Champions
rules.text: When a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit is selected to fight, if the S of those attacks is lower than the T of the target, those attacks have +1 to wound rolls.

rules.name: Searing Soulflame
rules.text: When you select a unit to be pinned by a friendly PURGATION SQUAD unit’s Righteous Persecution ability, that enemy unit makes a battle‑shock roll, with -1 to that battle‑shock roll.

rules.name: Echojump
rules.text: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly INTERCEPTOR SQUAD unit has shot, you can use this ability. If you do: - That unit <ins>cannot</ins> use its Personal Teleporters ability. - That unit can make a surge move of up to D6+1".
